design.error_and_unknown_semantics: Reject missing mapping, ambiguous listed contract, unqualified coverage, malformed timestamps, contradictory duplicates and traversal. Missing calendar intervals never become zero missing bars.
design.idempotency_and_recovery: Hash canonical content independent of Parquet bytes; exact repeat returns same dataset version; conflicting logical bar requires explicit versioned correction. Orphan staging is not a published dataset.
design.transaction_boundary: Stage CSV/Parquet and manifest in caller-owned temporary output root; atomic publish of verified immutable version directory. No PostgreSQL or canonical account writes.
